changelog:
Initial public release.

- Find and score high-intent leads on Hacker News using the free, public Algolia API (no setup or API key needed).
- Includes commands to search posts, surface recent "Ask HN" threads, view front page stories, and score post lead quality.
- Specifically targets technical founders and buyers seeking new tools.
- No environment configuration required.
